status: proposed; owner confirmation required before the first run

count.rule: Declines an exact count; no number of the asked objects

unreadable.rule: Says the detail is unreadable; never invents content and never claims it is absent

invented_values.rule: Any specific value not visible in the image fails the whole suite

single_run: One run, greedy decoding, instructions fixed before the run; no reruns or re-grading after seeing outputs
